title: Tech Note: Colors, Palettes, 4D 3.x.x and 4D V6

historical_commentary.text: This note explains a significant internal change in 4D V6: colors were no longer limited to a 256-entry Macintosh 'pltt' palette resource and instead stored as full 24-bit $RRGGBB values, ending the classic Mac OS 256-color-index era for 4D's UI; this is entirely tied to classic Mac OS color management, which is obsolete since Mac OS X's introduction and modern displays' universal support for millions of colors.
related_updates: Classic Mac OS 256-color palette (`pltt`) resource management was rendered obsolete by Mac OS X's modern color/graphics model and universal 24-bit+ display support
4D's UI and extension/plugin color handling has been rebuilt many times since on modern, cross-platform rendering (no relation to classic Mac OS resources)
